strings.Parses projects into a local dependency: 將專案解析為本機依賴關係圖，以找出受影響的測試與依賴項目
strings.answer which tests cover a change via MC: 透過 MCP 回答哪些測試涵蓋某項變更
strings.list who depends on a file by hop: 依層數列出相依於某檔案的對象
strings.pack project into portable aif.json cont: 將專案打包成可攜的 aif.json 脈絡檔案
strings.run only tests affected by uncommitted c: 只執行受未提交變更影響的測試
strings.show shortest import chain between two f: 顯示兩個檔案之間最短的 import 鏈
